[](https://www.finsmes.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Clarity-Systems.jpg)

**[Clarity Systems](https://claritysystems.ai/)** , a San Francisco, CA-based retail fraud detection company, raised $4.4M in Seed funding.

Backers included LMnT Ventures, Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures.

The company intends to use the funds to expand operations and its business reach.

Led by CEO Andy Ruben, Clarity Systems provides a retail fraud detection platform that combines diagnostic-grade X-ray intelligence with computer vision and AI to see inside returned and received products in three seconds or less without opening the box.
Their platform analyzes products and instantly detects anomalies such as counterfeit goods, product swaps, missing components, or other forms of return fraud by comparing items against their original manufacturer profile.
